placement.rationale: A separate 1990s sequel event, not an alternative selection of the 1970s Original Clone Saga. Its recalled Amazing Spider-Man #149 is shared background, not the same story. Clone Conspiracy is another later event and has no shared originals. Science fiction covers cloning, thriller covers the identity mystery, and street level describes the personal Spider-Man focus.
placement.yearBasis: The principal saga begins in 1994; earlier recalled origin issues do not move the story to 1975.

editorial.description: Ben Reilly's return forces Peter Parker to question which of them is the original Spider-Man. The struggle follows both men across the Spider-Man titles as clones and the Jackal upend their lives. Unresolved comics remain recorded in the source notes.

dispositions.rationale: Independently verified against main 4bdcfab0 and the candidate files. The three shared originals are Sensational Spider-Man (1996) #8 (issueId 51043, digitalId 35502), The Amazing Spider-Man (1963) #415 (6833, 10900) and Spider-Man (1990) #72 (10836, 11526). They carry identical issueId and digitalId values in both lists, at Onslaught positions 50, 51 and 53 and Second Clone Saga positions 121, 122 and 123. An independent intersection of the two payloads is exactly these three, and neither list contains the other, so partial is correct. Both digests were recomputed with the unchanged canonical JSON function from scripts/lib/cbh-inventory.mjs and match. Onslaught's identities, positions and placeholders are unchanged; both lists keep the shared originals as one shared read identity.
